description: Scores every DUE, unscored prediction in the ledger (log_prediction) as 'hit', 'miss' or 'unresolvable', and stores the outcome in ~/.suunto-mcp/predictions.json. Toward Suunto it only reads (workout list, sleep and recovery lists, laps of the guided sessions it needs; the same numbers as get_baselines and compare_workout_to_plan). Rules: session_done = a workout exists on the date; hrv_in_band = HRV of the night after the date against the user's 28-day band (get_baselines), inclusive; recovery_morning_at_least = Balance on waking after that night, at least the threshold (compared as printed, 2 decimals); reps_hit = the journal's logged sets of that exercise decide (a logged set without a weight takes the guide label's), and without logged sets only fewer set laps than predicted in a reliable per-set guide proves a miss. Only workouts that started after the prediction was made count. A reps_hit scored from a journal entry made from a confirmed draft_session_log (source 'draft') carries basis 'draft-confirmed' in its outcome; get_prediction_stats reports those apart. MISSING DATA: when a workout, or the night, is missing, the prediction stays PENDING (unscored, listed in `pending` with the reason) until the watch has synced data from a LATER day; only then is it a miss (no workout) or unresolvable (no night): a missing sync is never scored. UNRESOLVABLE means the data to decide was truly missing (no HRV that night, fewer than 7 nights for a band, nothing logged): it is never guessed and counts as neither hit nor miss. A failed request is NOT unresolvable: that prediction stays unscored, the error is in `errors`, and the next call tries again. Scored outcomes are final; an unresolvable one is read again only with rescoreUnresolvable: true (and written only if the answer changed). At most 20 predictions per call, oldest due first, NEVER-scored ones before the re-read unresolvable ones (so a call always advances through what is new): `remaining` says how many are left, call again. Calling it again with nothing newly due changes nothing and does not call Suunto. Output: { today, scored: [{ id, date, kind, result, detail }], hits, misses, unresolvable, pending: [{ id, date, kind, reason }], notDue, remaining, errors, notes }. Annotated not read-only (it writes outcomes locally), not destructive and not idempotent (each call scores the next batch); it never changes anything at Suunto. In demo mode the demo ledger is scored against the synthetic data and the outcomes stay in memory.

rescoreUnresolvable.description: true: also read again the predictions that were 'unresolvable' (more data may have arrived, e.g. after log_session). Default false.

name: score_predictions
title: Score due predictions against Suunto's data (hit / miss / unresolvable)
